task_definition.task_description: Please look up up to five headphones in electronics, check the latest business news, and then find me similar alternatives to the Sony WH-1000XM5 and pick one option for 1 unit. After that, place a hold on the selected item, confirm the order, generate a PayPal invoice for me at alice@company.com, then check the current BTC price and my investment account balance. Also get the weather alert for New York, publish a high-priority travel advisory to my app based on it, and then create a high-priority app summary document called "Purchase and Travel Advisory Summary" covering the purchase, invoice, weather, and portfolio info.

user_input.query: On the app channel, for user_01, please look up up to five headphones in electronics using the query "headphones," check the latest business news, and find similar alternatives to the Sony WH-1000XM5 for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk. Pick one option for quantity 1, place a hold on it, and confirm the order. Then generate a PayPal invoice to alice@company.com for payment_amount 199.99 using payment_gateway paypal and payment_method card, with invoice_items including product_id prod_12345 and quantity 1. After that, check the current BTC price and my investment account balance. Also get the weather alert for New York, publish a high-priority travel advisory to my app with priority high, and create a high-priority app summary document titled "Purchase and Travel Advisory Summary" covering the purchase, invoice, weather, and portfolio info. Please tag it with shopping, invoice, weather, and portfolio.
